At HEMA, we are building an efficient and future\-proof retail technology landscape. To achieve this, we are establishing a new Engineering Organization. This is your chance to help lay the technological foundation for the most iconic, nearly 100\-year\-old department store in the Netherlands. Do you want to make a direct impact on HEMA’s digital progress? Then this role is for you! **the challenge**  

  

  

As a Fullstack/Frontend Engineer in our growing composable front\-end team, you’ll be working on the new HEMA website, built in a modern storefront using Next.js. Here, you work side by side with HEMA developers and developers from our partners. Additionally, you have close contact with Product Owners, Business Owners, IT Analysts, and colleagues from the domain teams. However, your role goes beyond just programming; you help HEMA grow as a tech organization and enable the strategic road map. You collaborate with colleagues from other domains to deliver seamless connected solutions. You will work on challenging projects as well as contribute to building the future\-proof website of HEMA. * You work result\- and quality\-oriented, always with the customer at the center;
* Innovation in your field of work and curiosity towards new solutions;

jobs.title: Junior Engineer Industriële Informatica
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


Als MES Software Engineer heb jij directe invloed op de prestaties van complexe productieomgevingen. Of je nu werkt aan de digitalisering van een papierfabriek of het optimaliseren van een farmaceutische proceslijn. Zorg jij straks voor productieprocessen die echt op rolletjes lopen?
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Beeld je eens in: een grote internationale producent in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie kampt met verouderde software. Productiestilstand dreigt. Samen met een klein, deskundig team stap jij in. Binnen no\-time ontwikkelen jullie een slim, schaalbaar en stabiel MES\-systeem dat real\-time inzicht geeft in productiegegevens, en direct gekoppeld is aan PLC\- en SCADA\-lagen. Het resultaat: meer grip, hogere efficiëntie en een tevreden klant. Daar doe je het voor.


Als MES Software Engineer werk je aan hoogwaardige informatiesystemen binnen de industriële automatisering. Je werkt aan nieuwbouwprojecten en moderniseert bestaande productieomgevingen. Je krijgt de vrijheid om creatief en zelfstandig oplossingen te ontwerpen, te testen en te implementeren.


Waarom dit uniek is? Omdat je werkt in een organisatie zonder managers, met veel vertrouwen. Jouw kennis en initiatief maken het verschil. En het kantoor? Geen standaard grijs systeemplafond, maar een karakteristiek herenhuis met studentikoze charme waar je je meteen thuis voelt. Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden:

* Je werkt samen met projectteams aan maatwerksoftware voor industriële automatiseringsprojecten;
* Programmeert MES\-systemen voor verschillende productielijnen en installaties;
* Ontwikkelt software, visualisaties en algoritmen om productieprocessen te monitoren en aan te sturen;
* Vertaalt klantwensen naar functionele ontwerpen en technische documentatie;
* En je test en finetunet je eigen software en implementeert deze enkele keren per jaar op locatie bij de klant.


### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**

* Een hbo\- of wo\- diploma in Technische Informatica, Elektrotechniek, ICT, Systems \& Control of vergelijkbaar;
* Ervaring met .NET en C\#;
* Affiniteit met MES\-oplossingen en procesindustrie.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**

* Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3\.300,\- en € 4\.800,\-.
* 23 vakantiedagen
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Een auto van de zaak die je ook privé mag rijden.
* Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
* Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om vanuit huis te werken.
* Uitgebreide mogelijkheden om extra trainingen, cursussen of opleidingen te volgen.
* Een pensioen waar wij 2/3de deel betalen.
* Een contract voor 1 jaar, daarna direct een vast contract.


### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Wij zijn een gespecialiseerde System Integrator binnen de industriële automatisering, actief in uiteenlopende sectoren zoals watermanagement, energie, food, pharma, chemie, infrastructuur en datagedreven industrie. Met ruim 80 automatiseringsspecialisten werken we dagelijks aan projecten waarin PLC\-, DCS\- en SCADA\-technologie wordt gecombineerd met high\-end software, OT\-infrastructuur, MES en data\-oplossingen.


We hebben diverse vestigingen, maar werken met zo’n 80 collega’s vlakbij Utrecht, en we groeien gestaag door de stijgende vraag naar slimme automatisering. Wat ons bijzonder maakt? Er is geen sterke hiërarchie en de lijnen zijn kort. Vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal. Iedereen krijgt hier de ruimte om zijn stempel te drukken op projecten.


Ons hoofdkantoor ligt op een karakteristieke plek vlakbij Utrecht, een oud herenhuis vol sfeer, waar creativiteit en techniek samenkomen. Hier vind je geen strakke maatpakken of hiërarchische vergaderstructuren, maar collega’s met passie voor techniek, die met plezier samenwerken en elkaar vooruit helpen.

jobs.title: Internship: Generative AI Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Internship: Generative AI Engineer
### **Job Description**

**Start date:** November (we are flexible)


**Duration:** at least 3 months (with the option to extend)


**Type:** Internship, Non\-Thesis


**Weekly presence:** 40 hours (32 hours could be an option), at least 3x week on\-site


**Location:** Eindhoven HTC
  

  

**Job title: Internship: Generative AI Engineer**  

We're seeking an intern with hands\-on expertise in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing and Generative AI to join our team. In this role, you will design and build innovative and ethically responsible Generative AI solutions that effectively address real\-world problems, balancing technical feasibility with user needs and business impact. Working at the intersection of natural language processing and machine learning, you will contribute to developing AI solutions that directly impact patient outcomes and Philips' growth in the healthcare sector.  



  

**Your role:**

* Design, train, and evaluate NLP and LLM\-based solutions for various use cases, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), information retrieval \& search, chatbots, structured information extraction and named entity recognition, text generation, summarization, and more
* Clean, preprocess, and curate data for evaluation, fine\-tuning, and training
* Work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, formulate problems, and deliver data\-driven insights
Keep up the latest advancements in generative AI research and integrate new techniques into the development process  
* 

  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You are studying towards your Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* You have at least **one year of hands\-on experience developing NLP and ML/DL solutions** in an academic or professional environment gained during your studies (e.g. internship project)
* You are proficient in Python and relevant libraries for data science and deep learning (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
* You have a strong **understanding of classic NLP** and **experience with with LLMs** , such as RAG, prompt engineering, data synthesis, automatic evaluation, and fine\-tuning
* You are familiar with cloud computing platforms
* You have excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset are essential
You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail  
* 

  

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
  

  

**We offer you** :
  

A non\-stop growth opportunity within Marketing and Communication but also within a global multinational company. In addition, we also want to renumerate you well for the opportunity. This includes:


* Monthly full\-time allowance between €500 \- €700 gross, depending on your education level and if you need to relocate to The Netherlands. Part\-time internships receive the allowance pro\-rata.
* Housing compensation. Should you need to relocate to near our office, we’ll offer you a monthly allowance of €300,\- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,\- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, we’ll just ask for the rental contract from your landlord, and your usual home\-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1\.5 hours of travel time (for a one way trip).
* Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport card; you will receive max. €192,\- net as a monthly allowance.
* Paid holidays per internship term.
The opportunity to buy Philips products at our Philips shop.  
* 

  

**About Philips**  

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history .
* Learn more about our purpose .

  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here .

**De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als Release Train Engineer ART BASE.**


Wil je een uitdaging met een complex stakeholderveld: hebben we voor je. Wij zoeken een RTE voor de ART BASE. BASE staat voor het fundament waarop bedrijfsprocessen draaien. Denk aan finance, inkoop, logistiek en projectmanagement. Het ERP\-platform vormt de stabiele basis waarop collega's en partners dagelijks kunnen vertrouwen. * **Services mindset** – waarde leveren aan onze stakeholders.

Aan jou de uitdaging om onze agile teams nog succesvoller te maken, te faciliteren dat we waarde gedreven en realistische kwartaalplannen maken en te borgen dat we continu verbeteren. Je helpt de samenwerking met onze omgeving, waaronder die met andere ART’s en ketenpartners, verder te versterken.

  

  

De rol samengevat: jij helpt transparantie, resultaten, ambitie, continu verbeteren en samenwerking te vergroten en te verbeteren. Voor de ART en omgeving ben je sparringpartner, coach, kennisbron en inspirator.

* Voorbereiden, faciliteren en evalueren van PI\-planningen, System Demo’s en andere ART events.
* Signaleren van risico’s, afhankelijkheden, resourcing uitdagingen en volgen van de voortgang.
* Functioneel sturing en coaching geven aan de scrum masters.
* Analyseren van processen en werkwijzen, het voorstellen en implementeren van verbeteringen met als doel de ART efficiënt en effectief zichtbaar waarde te laten creëren.

Uitdragen en stimuleren van je kennis om Alliander verder te laten groeien op Agile vlak.

**Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander**


Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Samen met Liander, Qirion, Qterra, Dep en Entrnce ontwikkelen én beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners van Nederland. Dat doen we met de hulp van ruim 8\.000 vakmensen. Dankzij deze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij dat mogelijk. En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Alliander.

  

  

Talent herkennen en begeleiden kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jouw dat. Samen helpen we Alliander in het halen van de grote ambities met betrekking tot de energietransitie. Help jij ons met je expertise nog verder te groeien?

Werken aan een organisatie die toekomstproof is. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. En vul je dit daarnaast aan met:

**Application process**

CVs and cover letters are not required as part of the application process. Candidates will be assessed through a single\-stage strengths\-based interview.

  

Start your career with a global, employee\-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one.

  

**Job Description**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we believe engineering is more than just infrastructure—it’s about shaping a future that’s resilient, inclusive, and sustainable. As climate change challenges our environment and communities, civil engineers are at the heart of creating solutions that protect natural resources, improve lives, and foster economic and social growth for generations to come.

  

We are looking for passionate Graduate Civil \& Structural Engineers to make a meaninful mpact across our Energy sectors, with opportunities in:

  

* Transmission \& Distribution
* Nuclear and Defence
* Hydropower
You’ll work alongside experienced professionals on projects that matter—helping to create better cities, reduce poverty, and improve public health. You’ll be immersed in a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

  

**Transmission \& Distribution**

  

  

You will play a key role in designing and delivering the infrastructure that powers the UK’s transition to Net Zero. With the growing demand for renewable energy, your work will help ensure clean energy reaches homes, businesses, and even international markets through interconnectors to Europe.You’ll be directly involved in the design of critical infrastructure that supports the transmission of low\-carbon energy across the UK.  



**Nuclear and Defence**

  

  

Play a vital role in delivering safe, sustainable, carbon\-free power. Our teams work across nuclear new build, existing generation, decommissioning, waste management and defence\-related programmes, helping clients solve highly regulated technical challenges throughout the project lifecycle. Working in this area offers the opportunity to contribute to safe, sustainable, carbon\-free power and critical national infrastructure, while being part of a trusted team committed to safety, innovation and long\-term impact.  



**Hydropower**


Focusing on the development and delivery of renewable power projects that generate electricity from water, including conventional hydropower and pumped storage schemes. Projects typically involve dams, reservoirs, tunnels, waterways, powerhouses and associated civil, structural and electro\-mechanical infrastructure. Working in hydropower offers the opportunity to contribute to low\-carbon energy, energy security and resilient infrastructure on complex projects in the UK and internationally.

  

Within each sector your role may include


* Front\-End Engineering Design (FEED) and Detailed Design phases
* Civil works design, including platforms (earthworks, embankments, retaining walls), access roads (temporary and permanent), and drainage systems (SuDS, Infodrainage)
* Structural design, covering foundations, beams, columns, and connections
* Feasibility studies and optioneering exercises to identify optimal solutions
* Site visits to assess conditions and support construction phases
**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.

  

To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements**) and have a minimum of a bachelors degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines:


* Civil Engineering
* Structural Engineering
  

For some of our opportunities, a master’s degree is essential – this is reflected in the list of opportunities in the application form.

  

Some of these opportunities will require you to be eligible to achieve security clearance. Security clearance is dictated by the types of projects we work on and normally requires you to be a UK British national or lived in the UK for five years or more.

  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.

  

We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:

  

* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
  

**UK Immigration**


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\.


Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long\-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time\-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.


We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. **Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Employee Ownership**


* Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
* Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
* As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long\-term impact and contribution.
* Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Lifestyle**

* 33 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* 10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.

**Enhanced family and carers leave**


* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
